CustomField.description: Optional per-template site address. When filled, Web_Form_URL__c uses it instead of Flow_Tool_Kit_Settings__c.Default_Web_Form_URL__c. For templates whose form lives on a different site than the org default.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Fill only when this form lives on a different site than the Default Web Form URL in Flow Tool Kit Settings. Enter the page that shows the form, for example https://www.example.org/forms. The template Id is added to the end.
CustomField.label: Web Form Site URL
